The Text must be the exact handle referenced by a standard Title/Subtitle/XLabel/YLabel/ZLabel role on the same canonical assembly axes. All axes identities, positions, ordering, labels and every other property remain exact.
Only the two complete typed fieldless editor values listed here are permitted. Record all original values and identities; never modify/resave canonical figures or discard other native fields.

Every assembly image CData must equal its validated canonical panel texture, with the existing canonical-ED5b assembly rule unchanged. Panel order, annotations, fonts, styles, layout, source hashes and all scientific arrays remain exact.
Both assembly PNGs require exact whole-image dimensions and RGBA equality, including independent repeat exports. No assembly pixel exception or additional ED5b pixel location/colour.
No visible/nonempty axes labels, annotation Text, other objects, other Interaction classes, nonempty editor properties, new roles or other assemblies are eligible.
All numerical/statistical/source/preservation checks, original Fig6c bytes, both prior exact approved scopes and their original approval records remain unchanged. No automatic expansion.
